verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that Pinecone offers serverless indexes, for multitenancy and backups, but nothing documents usage-based billing or transparent per-unit costs. The serverless mentions are an adjacent architectural feature, not pricing evidence. The community note about a generous free tier is not usage-based per-unit pricing either, so neither counts as support.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pay serverless usage-based pricing with transparent per-unit costs instead of provisioning fixed clusters
